title: A speck of eager fire from foxeyes thanked him. He withdrew his gaze after an instant. No: better not: another time.
html_source: We don’t know the rational behind Bloom’s decision to do something another time nor do we know what he intends to when the moment suits him better. The narrative in Calypso conceals reason ; it takes place in a chapter named after the Greek witch Calypso or ‘The Concealer’ (Norris, M. Virgin and Veteran Readings of Ulysses, p87.).
